narrative_purpose: Contrasts the two grades of emergence the chapter hinges on: weak emergence, where a surprising global pattern still rises cleanly from local rules (drawn as many simple parts forming one coherent flowing shape), versus strong emergence, where a higher level is imagined reaching back down to push the parts around — the steep wall a network would have to clear to be a mind.
subject: A two-zone naturalist diagram. Lower-left zone: a dense field of identical simple glowing cells from which a single large coherent swirling pattern visibly assembles, the flow rising upward — order built from below. Upper-right zone, set apart by a faint steep ridge or step: a luminous higher form shown sending influence back DOWN onto the cells beneath it, the downward direction emphasised, rendered as rarer and more uncertain, almost dreamlike.
scene: A single dark field divided by a faint rising step between the two zones, suggesting an easy slope on one side and a steep wall on the other.
camera: A clean diagrammatic side-on view, the two zones legible at a glance.
light: Cyan-teal glow on the self-assembling lower swirl (confident, solid); a fainter, cooler, more ethereal magenta-tinged glow on the upper downward-causing form to mark it as the contested case.
palette: Void-indigo base, Pandora cyan and living teal for the weak-emergence swirl, a scarce uncertain magenta accent for the strong-emergence form above.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate with faint diagrammatic structure.
detail_level: Crisp on the lower self-assembling pattern; deliberately softer and more dissolved on the upper contested form.
composition: Diagonal split low-left to upper-right with a felt step between; generous dark space beside each zone for labels.
consistency_notes: Abstract concept figure kept in the book's cool palette and from-within glow; the upper form is intentionally fainter/rarer to read as the harder, contested case. Leave dark margins for callouts.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
